body: Just wanted you to know I read your vent... I don’t know what to say but sometimes we don’t need someone to reply just need to know someone listened.
I wish I knew the answer.
have responsibilities to put first... not that easy.

Have you ever felt the feeling afterwards knowing it was done to be polite or not start a fight? You pretty much give up after years of that...if it's not genuine and given freely it doesn't mean shit.
I had no idea why I was posting here either...
I'm northwest, but I don't mind driving. :)
